name: CLOUDPT
recent: Cloudpoint Technology 近期完成凭单派发计划，除权日为2026年11月6日，每2股现有普通股获1张凭单，行使价RM0.38，凭单于11月20日上市。公司CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong 在11月期间有股份交易活动。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长31.0%，但净利同比下滑24.8%。
notable: 完成凭单派发计划，每2股现有普通股获1张凭单，行使价RM0.38，凭单于2026年11月20日上市。
CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong 于2026年11月16日以每股RM0.425增持69,900股。
risks: 凭单行使价RM0.38较理论除权价RM0.4479折让15.16%，未来行使可能带来股份摊薄。
CEO在闭门期前表示有意进行股份交易，并在闭门期内增持股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为MYR 45.614百万，环比增长31.0%，同比微增0.1%；净利为MYR 4.142百万，环比增长109.8%，但同比下滑24.8%；净利率为9.1%，高于上一季度的5.7%。

recent_en: Cloudpoint Technology recently completed its bonus issue of warrants, with ex-date on 6 Nov 2026 on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing shares at an exercise price of RM0.38; the warrants were listed on 20 Nov 2026. CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong had share dealings in November. Latest quarter (ended 30 Jun 2026) revenue rose 31.0% QoQ but net profit fell 24.8% YoY.
notable_en: Completed bonus issue of warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing shares at an exercise price of RM0.38; warrants listed on 20 Nov 2026.
CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong acquired 69,900 shares at RM0.425 per share on 16 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Warrant exercise price of RM0.38 represents a 15.16% discount to the theoretical ex-all price of RM0.4479, with potential future dilution upon exercise.
CEO indicated intention to deal during closed period and acquired shares within the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 45.614 million, up 31.0% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net profit was MYR 4.142 million, up 109.8% QoQ but down 24.8% YoY; net margin was 9.1% versus 5.7% in the previous quarter.
